text: Analyse how the extract from Roar constructs meaning, including the specific representations of
individuals/groups/events/places, through the following technical elements:
• camera shots, angles, movement and composition
• sound
• mise-en-scène
• editing.
Extract: Roar (episode 1, ‘The Woman Who Disappeared’, dir. Godfrey Peoples) [25]
Section B: Media contexts
Answer one question from Section B.
You should make references to at least one case study in your answer.
EITHER
Assess the significance of technological convergence on the ways in which audiences consume
media products. [25]
OR
‘The days of the all-powerful media owner dictating content are over; media organisations and
their messages are much more complex these days.’ To what extent do you agree with this
statement? [25]
